behavior_constraints: ServiceConfig gains a DependsOn []string field (TOML key depends_on), default empty array
api-gateway service config must set depends_on = ["data-store"]; data-store and cache-layer have no dependencies
Before accepting any new connection and before rate-limit check, every service in depends_on must have at least one healthy endpoint with circuit breaker closed
If a dependency check fails, the connection is rejected immediately with access log result "rejected_dependency"
Access log entries for rejected_dependency must include a failed_dependency field naming the first unavailable dependency service
A new per-service stat dependency_rejections counts dependency rejections and appears in stats output
New IPC command get_dependencies accepts {"name":"<service>"} and returns service name plus a dependencies array with name, available (bool), and healthy_endpoints (int) per dependency
New CLI subcommand meshctl deps [service] prints a table with columns SERVICE, DEPENDS_ON, AVAILABLE, HEALTHY_ENDPOINTS
When no service argument is given to meshctl deps, show all services that have at least one dependency configured
At initial config load and on SIGHUP reload, circular dependencies are detected; if a cycle is found a warning is logged and the edge that closes the cycle is dropped
affected_prior: internal/state/json.go (StatsView and dependency view from rounds 1/4)
entities.summary: This round adds per-service dependency health checking so connections are rejected when a depended-on service has no healthy circuit-closed endpoint, with a new rejected_dependency access log result, dependency_rejections stat, get_dependencies IPC command, meshctl deps CLI subcommand, and circular-dependency detection at config load and reload.

instruction_head:
Now add service dependency health checking to meshrouter.

Add a `depends_on` field to each service block in the config (array of service names, default empty). For example, setting `depends_on = ["data-store"]` on api-gateway means api-gateway requires data-store to be available before accepting connections.

Update the existing `api-gateway` service config to set `depends_on = ["data-store"]`. Leave `data-store` and `cache-layer` with no dependencies by default.
